description: This file contains a test class `SingleStreamTestRunner` that provides various scenarios for testing streaming functionalities within the Orleans framework. It includes setup for producers and consumers, different configurations for joining and deactivation, and methods to run various streaming tests such as one-to-one, many-to-many, producer-only, consumer-only, and specific edge cases like immutability and reactivation.

classes.name: SingleStreamTestRunner
classes.description: A test utility class designed to run comprehensive streaming tests in the Orleans framework, supporting various configurations and scenarios for producers and consumers.

methods.name: StreamTest_01_OneProducerGrainOneConsumerGrain
methods.description: Tests a scenario where a single producer grain and a single consumer grain join a stream, with different join orders.

methods.name: StreamTest_02_OneProducerGrainOneConsumerClient
methods.description: Tests a scenario with producer grain and consumer client objects.

methods.name: StreamTest_03_OneProducerClientOneConsumerGrain
methods.description: Tests producer and consumer as client objects on grains.

methods.name: StreamTest_04_OneProducerClientOneConsumerClient
methods.description: Tests producer and consumer both as client objects.

methods.name: StreamTest_05_ManyDifferent_ManyProducerGrainsManyConsumerGrains
methods.description: Tests many-to-many streaming with multiple producer and consumer grains.

methods.name: StreamTest_06_ManyDifferent_ManyProducerGrainManyConsumerClients
methods.description: Tests many-to-many with grains as producer and client objects as consumers.

methods.name: StreamTest_07_ManyDifferent_ManyProducerClientsManyConsumerGrains
methods.description: Uses client producer objects and grain consumers in a many-to-many setup.

methods.name: StreamTest_08_ManyDifferent_ManyProducerClientsManyConsumerClients
methods.description: Both producers and consumers are client objects in a many-to-many configuration.

methods.name: StreamTest_09_ManySame_ManyProducerGrainsManyConsumerGrains
methods.description: Multiple producer and consumer grains sharing the same grain IDs.

methods.name: StreamTest_10_ManySame_ManyConsumerGrainsManyProducerGrains
methods.description: Consumer grains joining before producers with shared grain IDs.

methods.name: StreamTest_11_ManySame_ManyProducerGrainsManyConsumerClients
methods.description: Multiple producer grains with shared IDs and multiple client consumers.

methods.name: StreamTest_12_ManySame_ManyProducerClientsManyConsumerGrains
methods.description: Client producers with shared IDs and grain consumers.

methods.name: StreamTest_13_SameGrain_ConsumerFirstProducerLater
methods.description: Testing scenario where a consumer and producer share the same grain, with consumer joining first.

methods.name: StreamTest_14_SameGrain_ProducerFirstConsumerLater
methods.description: Producer joins first, then consumer on same grain.

methods.name: StreamTest_15_ConsumeAtProducersRequest
methods.description: Tests a scenario where a producer directly calls a consumer to subscribe, reproducing a deadlock scenario.

methods.name: StreamTest_16_Deactivation_OneProducerGrainOneConsumerGrain
methods.description: Tests deactivation and reactivation of producer and consumer grains.

methods.name: BasicTestAsync
methods.description: Runs a basic series of produce/consume checks including sequential, parallel, and periodic series.

methods.name: StopProxies
methods.description: Stops producer and consumer proxies and verifies cleanup.

methods.name: CheckCounters
methods.description: Verifies that the expected number of items have been produced and consumed.

methods.name: AssertProducerCount
methods.description: Confirms the number of active producers on the SMS stream provider.

methods.name: ValidatePubSub
methods.description: Validates the pub/sub setup for a given stream id and provider.

methods.name: CheckGrainsDeactivated
methods.description: Checks whether specified grains have been deactivated, used after test deactivation and reactivation.
